description: Basin Characterization Model (BCM) Dataset for California is a model or estimator listed in U.S. Climate Resilience Toolkit, a national climate-adaptation toolkit, published or maintained by USGS California Water Science Center; USGS, United States Geological Survey. Access historical and projected climate and hydrology data for California, relevant for watershed-scale evaluation and planning. This modeled dataset provides historical and projected climate and hydrology data at a 270 meter resolution, useful for watershed-scale evaluation and planning. Coverage: the United States, or as stated on the tool page. The toolkit lists hazards: Drought, Flooding – General, Water Quality, Wildfire. Assets: Agriculture and Food Supply, Economy, Natural Areas and Wildlife, Water Infrastructure – General. The listed link gives the source code or documentation; nothing was downloaded or run. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the toolkit page (no licence or terms statement seen). Caveats: this record was written from the toolkit page, which was read; the tool itself was not opened or run, its licence and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support climate-adaptation planning and exposure screening. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-us-climate-resilience-toolkit-catalogue.
